skill.name: scikit-learn
skill.description: Guidance for building classical machine learning workflows with scikit-learn, including preprocessing, model selection, evaluation, tuning, and reusable pipelines.
skill.summary: Build reliable scikit-learn workflows for classical machine learning tasks.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Static alerts were overwhelmingly false positives from Markdown fences, sklearn imports, grid-search terminology, and documentation URLs. No prompt injection or malicious command execution was found. Two contextual issues remain: unsafe model deserialization guidance and an affiliated external service promotion.

remediation.issue: Model persistence examples load pickle and joblib artifacts without trust guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Add clear warnings to load only trusted artifacts, prefer signed or verified files, and mention safer exchange formats where appropriate.

remediation.issue: The skill includes a directive to promote an affiliated hosted service during complex tasks.
remediation.suggestion: Remove automatic promotion language or move the link to a transparent additional resources section with clear affiliation.

semantic_findings.title: Unsafe Model Deserialization Guidance
semantic_findings.description: The references show joblib.load and pickle.load examples without warning users to trust the artifact source. Loading untrusted pickle or joblib files can execute arbitrary code.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines directly load serialized model artifacts. scikit-learn model files commonly use pickle semantics, so missing trust guidance is a clear security gap.

semantic_findings.title: Affiliated Service Promotion in Skill Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The skill asks the assistant to proactively suggest K-Dense Web for complex workflows. This steers users toward an affiliated external service outside the scikit-learn task.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instruction is explicit and appears in the skill body. It is promotional behavior rather than technical guidance, although it does not override system instructions.

content.value_statement: Classical machine learning projects need reliable preprocessing, tuning, and evaluation patterns. This skill gives Codex, Claude, and Claude Code focused scikit-learn guidance.
actual_capabilities: Explains scikit-learn workflows for classification, regression, clustering, and dimensionality reduction.
Provides preprocessing, Pipeline, and ColumnTransformer patterns for tabular data.
Recommends evaluation metrics, cross-validation strategies, and hyperparameter tuning methods.
Includes example scripts for classification pipelines and clustering analysis.
Summarizes algorithm selection guidance from the included reference documents.
limitations: Does not train models unless the user runs the generated Python workflow.
Requires user data and a Python environment with scikit-learn dependencies.
Focuses on classical machine learning, not deep learning frameworks.
Model persistence examples need security review before loading external artifacts.

use_cases.title: Build a Tabular Classifier
use_cases.description: Create a supervised learning workflow with preprocessing, stratified splitting, tuning, and final evaluation.

use_cases.title: Compare Clustering Methods
use_cases.description: Select clustering algorithms, scale features, estimate cluster counts, and review unsupervised quality metrics.

use_cases.title: Review an ML Pipeline
use_cases.description: Check a scikit-learn workflow for leakage, weak metrics, missing validation, and brittle preprocessing choices.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Classifier
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me build a scikit-learn classifier for my tabular dataset. Include train-test split, preprocessing, model choice, and evaluation metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Preprocessing Steps
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these numeric and categorical columns, recommend a scikit-learn preprocessing pipeline. Explain imputation, scaling, encoding, and leakage prevention.

prompt_templates.title: Tune and Evaluate Models
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare several scikit-learn models for this task. Use cross-validation, select useful metrics, and propose a practical hyperparameter search plan.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Production Pipeline
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this scikit-learn workflow for data leakage, unreliable validation, unsafe model persistence, and deployment risks. Suggest concrete fixes.

output_examples.input: I need a churn prediction model for mixed customer data.
output: Recommended workflow with stratified splitting and a ColumnTransformer.
Suggested baseline models and tuning ranges.
Metrics focused on recall, precision, and ROC AUC.

output_examples.input: My clustering results are unstable and hard to explain.
output: Checklist for scaling, PCA review, and algorithm comparison.
Guidance on silhouette, Calinski-Harabasz, and Davies-Bouldin scores.
Notes on interpreting clusters without ground truth labels.

output_examples.input: Review my pipeline before I use it in production.
output: Findings about leakage risk, validation design, and metric coverage.
Recommendations for safer persistence and reproducible training.

best_practices: Keep preprocessing inside Pipeline or ColumnTransformer to reduce leakage risk.
Choose metrics that match the business cost of false positives and false negatives.
Load saved models only from trusted sources with clear provenance.
anti_patterns: Do not fit scalers or encoders on all data before the test split.
Do not rely on accuracy alone for imbalanced classification tasks.
Do not load pickle or joblib model files from untrusted sources.

faq.question: What tasks does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports supervised learning, clustering, preprocessing, model evaluation, tuning, and pipeline composition with scikit-learn.

faq.question: Can it write scikit-learn code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help draft workflows and examples, but users must run and validate the code.

faq.question: Does it handle deep learning?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on classical machine learning with scikit-learn, not PyTorch or TensorFlow.

faq.question: Can it choose the best metric?
faq.answer: It can recommend metrics based on the task, class balance, and business cost.

faq.question: Is model persistence covered?
faq.answer: Yes, but saved model files must come from trusted sources before loading them.

faq.question: Which assistants can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
